title: Adorable
text: Adorable. I haven't used anything yet. I just opened the box and it's so adorable. I didn't pay attention to size but feel like it was all a bargain even though it's small. It reminds me of my easy bake oven. Servings for one on the pie/cake pan for sure. The little loaf pan would feed 2. My air fryer is not the small size so it's my mistake, but I actually love it. I think it will cook better and faster because of the size. I've tried regular sized cakes and loaves that have come out not so great. By the time the center's done the sides are dried out barely edible. For now, I'm giving it a 5-star rating. If it changes after use, I'll review it again. I definitely need those pot grabbers. Big ones are too bulky and get in my food when I'm trying to remove it making a mess. The muffin pan would be perfect for cooking eggs too. That's about the size of muffin or cupcake you'd have. The metal trays are heavy duty and not flimsy at all. The tongs are small and perfect for grabbing hot stuff and not getting burned. So far, I love it. I'm cooking for one and not a whole family, so I think it would work out great.
